basis: The existing white icon is the composition reference. The separately exported transparent PNG is not treated as a pixel-aligned master.
normalization: Preserve the folded B silhouette, two triangular counters, dark body and two light return faces. Replace raster texture and inconsistent edge directions with shared filled-path geometry.

color_sampling.coordinates: Pixel rectangles [left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive], RGB medians
color_sampling.shared_fold: #969799; the common flat gray is the two regional medians averaged and rounded upward at .5

landmark_method: Approximate manual readings from the viewed 1254px reference; not subpixel measurements or recovered original design intent. Vertex letters correspond to geometry.json.
